_readme: The derivation vocabulary, shared so that a policy author and an enforcement point agree on
A derived act is one the enforcement point synthesises from a broad act's arguments:
`terminal` carrying a `curl` becomes `terminal.network` as well. Those names are never sent
by a host, so any tool that checks a policy against a host's tool list would call every one
of them dead. This file is how such a check tells a legitimate derived act from a typo.
Canonical here. `hermes-plugin/test_derive.py` asserts the Python constants match this file,
and it is mirrored into PromptForge's governance-pdp package for the publish-time check.
Adding a facet means adding it here first.
